caption: The drawing depicts a decorative ceramic plate with an octagonal shape, viewed from the top and in profile. The rim and much of the surface are covered in a mottled, splattered blue color, with segmented lines dividing the rim into sections. The central area of the plate features a stylized bird, which has a yellow body, a green wing, a red head crest, and a long, flowing red tail. The bird has a black beak, legs, and outlines, and is positioned standing sideways, facing left. Below the top view, there is a side-profile technical drawing of the plate in black and gray, showing its shape and profile depth. The diameter of the plate is marked at 8 5/8 inches. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Plate
